blocks.text: OPINI - yesterday because of Israel, there were people who deliberately hit Jokowi with Megawati. Someone also tried to hit Jokowi with Ganjar. It just makes sense and it doesn't make any sense.
Then Jokowi's figure got close to the Prabowo. There was also something that got close to Erick Thohir. Yeah, it's normal, but someone wants to reach out in the murky water.
If these people aren't Jokowi's supporters, I understand. They don't understand Jokowi's symbol language.
But it's a little strange that that person is a supporter of Jokowi. Because they should have understood Jokowi outside-deep.
For those who have read Jokowi since 2012, will understand that Jokowi's gesture is divided. The first gesture is the political gesture.
When Jokowi supported Prabowo, Sandiaga, Erick, or anyone to play in capresan, it was a political gesture.
Jokowi did respect them. Because they're the people he trusted in his cabinet. But for the greater good, to continue the country's ideals, not the political gesture to be read.
Because it takes a single decision that cannot be made. There can only be one real name to give him a mandate. Because it concerns the fate of Indonesia.
The second is a gesture born from the heart. Those at the Palace must have understood how Jokowi responded when facing people who really clicked with Jokowi.
That man, one of them was Ganjar Pranowo.
Jokowi support to Ganjar is no longer the language of symbols. I didn't hear it directly, or maybe I forgot. But please ask Denny Siregar or Eko Kuntadhi who met Jokowi several times.
Could have asked Abu Widows before he supported Prabowo. It's the Japanese name that echoes on the palace walls. Jokowi's volunteer then agreed to appoint Ganjar as the successor of Jokowi.
The decision was unanimous because volunteers realized, in every way, Ganjar was the most ideal choice as the successor of Jokowi.
Ganjar is special to Jokowi. Not just because he was a party cader, or because he was both from Central Java. But since today, only Ganjar has a heart-to-heart with Jokowi.
This is what led Jokowi to denounce his son, Gibran, for making inappropriate comments. And then gave Gibran directions to apologize.

Because Ganjar's statement was only to carry on the party's trust. He has personally supported a good effort to make the name Indonesia. He always supported Jokowi's policies and ideals for Indonesia.
Tensions built by those who don't know Jokowi are being carried out in the middle of a course.
In the next few days, Ganjar will always be in league with Jokowi. That's to say publicly, that Jokowi's relationship with Ganjar remains close and warm.
A sweet smile meeting has begun in Solo, when Jokowi and Ganjar prayers Friday at Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. It's what Ganjar told the normal reporters. It's a work thing.
But yes it can't be just discussing jobs. Just get it. What's being said there is not supposed to be publicly delivered.
Please read Jokowi's look-see, the look on his face. It's all very clear in there. Without having to listen to their conversation.
The history of their proximity is long enough. They both support and strengthen each other. In fact, it's all this time that made Ganjar strong and confident yes just Jokowi.
Back in Ganjar at the kuyo, in this place, Jokawi gave us hope and protection. Jokowi has even prepared the worst scenario for Ganjar.
So the narrative about both of them stretching is preposterous. Because to Ganjar, Jokowi is a protector, senior, mentor, as well as friend.
Then the disappointed Jokowi must know, from the very beginning only Ganjar allowed by Jokowi. Because other options are risky.
Long before Ganjar's name was played as a capres, Jokowi had given support and a sermon. Because this Ganjar story is similar to that of Jokowi.
Jokowi was also a cuyo-kuyo, and there were these here. Even his senior was a Waluyo Bibit, which is also a PDIP cadre, declaring open animosity with him.
This is what makes Jokowi's heart melt when he sees his junior experience the same way.
Jokowi understood, the rambling about Israel let some people down. But there are far greater interests to be fought for. It's to make sure that his successor is not a man of word.
Indonesia can't retreat backwards. Especially until it leaves its legacy racing everywhere.
Then Jokowi must be the one who understands Jokowi's ideals and struggles. Must have a sensitivity to the little wong.
The most rational choice is Ganjar Pranowo. History has bound its second heart, both history and the one that will incorporate Indonesia into its golden period.

Because Ganjar is going to go ahead and hang on to Jokowi's dreams. Until then, the next successor will arrive, until 2045. It could have been Gibran. When Indonesia became one of the four giant economies that the world was meant for.

For that, we must all look far ahead. Put together a line and follow Jokowi's command to support his successor. Your chest may be torn from disappointment, but the spirit of supporting good men must remain red-lit.
Kajitow Elkayeni
